patches.name: Uncensor patch (to buy)
patches.notes: Install (PC): Option 1: Download the patch archive from the MangaGamer website Extract the contents of the downloaded patch archive onto your computer Run 'update_en.exe' (or 'update_en_x86.exe' for 32 bit systems) from the extracted files and follow the prompts Option 2: Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch archive It's working if: "(R18)" is in the title bar after the name of the game. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
